scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @aquaculture/api" "npm run dev -w @aquaculture/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aquaculture/api && npm run build -w @aquaculture/web
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.mobile:copy: npm run mobile:build && npx cap copy
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @aquaculture/api && npm run lint -w @aquaculture/web
